## 1. data prep 

```{r}

## 0. library
library(edgeR)
library(here)

## 1. access Young's 
young <- here("..", "00_Young2021_OpenDataCode", "TB PANDA")
list.files(young)
list.files(file.path(young, "rdata"))

## load dge into its own environment
e <- new.env()
loaded <- load(file.path(young, "rdata", "dge.rdata"), envir = e)
loaded                      # name(s) of the object(s) in the file
dge <- e[[loaded[1]]]
class(dge)                  # DE results table, not counts
names(dge)                  



# check log2CPM and look for the raw counts and sample sheet


## log2CPM matrix
e2 <- new.env()
loaded2 <- load(file.path(young, "rdata", "log2CPM.RData"), envir = e2)
loaded2
lcpm <- e2[[loaded2[1]]]
class(lcpm); dim(lcpm)          # hoping for genes x 69
lcpm[1:5, 1:5]
colnames(lcpm)                  # sample names often encode time/treatment/batch

## find raw counts and sample info anywhere in the folder
list.files(young, recursive = TRUE,
           pattern = "count|sample|meta|design|target|pheno",
           ignore.case = TRUE)
list.files(file.path(young, "data", "panda"))

## see how the authors built log2CPM
rmd <- readLines(file.path(young, "npjsysbio.Rmd"))
grep("log2CPM|cpm\\(|DGEList|counts", rmd, value = TRUE)

```

get the sample table 

```{r}

lcpm_rb <- e2[["log2CPM.rm.batch"]]

meta <- data.frame(sample = colnames(lcpm))
parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(meta$sample, "_"))
meta$treatment  <- factor(parts[, 1], levels = c("DMSO", "T4", "T10"))
meta$time       <- factor(parts[, 2], levels = c("0hr", "12hr", "24hr", "48hr"))
meta$experiment <- factor(parts[, 3])
meta$rep        <- parts[, 4]

table(meta$treatment, meta$time)
table(meta$experiment, meta$time)
identical(colnames(lcpm), colnames(lcpm_rb))   # should be TRUE

```
